subject: Maple State Data Justice Lab — emergency trial credit top-up request
related_account: Maple State University Data Justice Lab
body:
--- Message 1 ---
From: Dr. Lila Patel <lila.patel@maplestate.edu>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Amina Osei <amina.osei@maplestate.edu>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: emergency top-up of trial credits for Data Justice pilot

Hi Naomi,

Quick ask from the Data Justice Lab at Maple State: we're three weeks into a funding-constrained annotation pilot (course + community volunteers) running on Redwood. Our team hit an unexpected surge in usage after adding audio transcription and sentiment NER for multilingual feeds. We're forecasted to run out of our trial allocation in 6 days, which would halt student work mid-term and jeopardize a grant report due Nov 1.

Can Redwood do a one-off trial credit top-up (approx 35k tokens) or extend the trial by two weeks while we process a campus grant request? We understand promotional credits are limited — if helpful, attaching the project summary and our IRB confirmation.

Attachment: proposal-summary.pdf (PDF)
Attachment: IRB_letter.pdf (PDF)

Appreciate any help — short timeline on our side. Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to go over usage and expected burn.

Thanks,
Lila

Dr. Lila Patel
Director, Data Justice Lab
Maple State University
lila.patel@maplestate.edu
--- End Message 1 ---

--- Message 2 (internal response) ---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Lila Patel <lila.patel@maplestate.edu>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: emergency top-up of trial credits for Data Justice pilot

Hi Lila — thanks for the clear context and the attachments. This is the sort of community pilot our promo fund is meant to support.

Ben (cc) — can you confirm whether we can approve a 35k-token top-up or a 2-week trial extension for Maplestate Data Justice Lab? If a small promo code is possible, I'll fast-track approvals and provide the redemption link.

Marissa — please note for reporting; would like to record this under EDU_PROMO_Q4.

I'll stand by for the outcome but want to flag urgency.

Best,
Naomi

Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Manager, Education
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
--- End Message 2 ---

--- Message 3 (internal decision) ---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: emergency top-up of trial credits for Data Justice pilot

Naomi — good to help them. Two options I can authorize without exec sign-off:

- Option A: 40k token promotional credit (single-use promo code, expires 2028-11-15)
- Option B: 14-day trial extension (keeps current rate-limits and metering, no code required)

If they can confirm they'll finish annotation pipeline within the two weeks, Option B is lower touch. Option A gives them headroom if usage stays high. We should ask for a short follow-up note from their PI confirming the timeline for our records.

Marissa — I'll log this under EDU_PROMO_FY28. Please add the HubSpot activity and attach the proposal.

Ben

Ben Carter
Head, Education Programs
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
--- End Message 3 ---

--- Message 4 (external reply, final) ---
From: Dr. Lila Patel <lila.patel@maplestate.edu>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Amina Osei <amina.osei@maplestate.edu>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: emergency top-up of trial credits for Data Justice pilot

Naomi/Ben — thank you both. We discussed and the simplest is Option A (promo credit). The lab lead (myself) confirms the project will complete within three weeks and we'll submit a brief usage summary and student citations to Redwood for your EDU case study program.

Would you send the promo code and any instructions for redeeming? Also, could you include a consolidated usage estimate template — we need to include numbers in our internal grant paperwork.

Grateful for the quick turnaround.

Warmly,
Lila

Dr. Lila Patel
Director, Data Justice Lab
Maple State University
lila.patel@maplestate.edu
[attachment: IRB_letter.pdf]

--- Message 5 (internal finalization) ---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Dr. Lila Patel <lila.patel@maplestate.edu>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 15:59:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: emergency top-up of trial credits for Data Justice pilot

Lila — great. I've generated the promo code and attached the quick-steps below. Ben/Marissa: I've logged the HubSpot activity and added the attachments per request.

Promo code: REDWOOD-EDU-40K-10-19
Expires: 2028-11-15
Redeem: Console > Billing > Apply promo code (one-time)
Notes: Code applies to token consumption only; no billing change is made to account metadata. Please confirm after you redeem so we can close the promo activity.

Usage estimate template (CSV): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4/usage-template
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/2345

Please reply once redeemed and we'll mark EDU_PROMO_FY28 as complete.

Thanks and good luck with the class — appreciate you offering students hands-on infra experience.

Naomi

Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Manager, Education
Redwood Inference
aurora.feldman@redwood.com
--- End Message 5 ---
